title: org.ligatureprotocol.person
description: DRAFT. The payload of a person fact: the master key, the self-chosen display name, and the self-signing and user-signing public keys with the master key's signatures over them. Carried in an envelope signed by the self-signing key; handed over in the pairing ceremony that establishes the person role and gossiped like any other fact (spec chapters 01 and 06). The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

bytes.description: Bytes as base64url without padding; a CBOR byte string on the wire.

subordinateKey.description: A key signed by the master key.

masterSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the master key over the byte concatenation "ligature/subkey/1" || purpose ("self-signing" or "user-signing") || the key's raw bytes (ADR 0035).

displayName.description: Self-chosen. What a prompt shows instead of the key.

selfSigningKey.description: Held by introducers; signs bindings and principals.

userSigningKey.description: Signs known persons and group acceptances.

version.description: Increases with every change; a device keeps the highest version it has verified.
